title: Galyleo Extension
description: Settings for the Galyleo Dashboard Editor extension.

studioURL.title: Studio URL
studioURL.description: URL of the Galyleo editor page. Defaults to the hosted editor on GitHub Pages. Override for self-hosted or local dev.

publishServer.title: Publish Server
publishServer.description: Base URL of the Galyleo publish / SDTP server.

tableServers.title: Table Servers
tableServers.description: List of SDTP table server base URLs available in the editor. If empty, publishServer is used as the sole table server.
